start.content: The council chamber was closed to many of us tonight. Whatever decisions were made inside, they were done inn secret.

steps.text: The council chamber was closed to many of us tonight. Whatever decisions were made inside, they were done inn secret.

after_arrest.content: After the Galilean was led away, the council rushed into emergency session. The doors were barred. The few of us still outside could hear raised voices — not debate, but something closer to panic dressed as procedure.

steps.text: After the Galilean was led away, the council rushed into emergency session. The doors were barred. The few of us still outside could hear raised voices — not debate, but something closer to panic dressed as procedure.

witnesses.content: The ones who testified were not surprise witnesses. The arrest had been planned for days — the witnesses were assembled before the kiss in the garden. Two witnesses came forward to say he could rebuild the temple in the three day.

exposed.content: The Law requires two or three witnesses. They had them ready. The conviction was pre-arranged. The sentence was decided before the accused entered the chamber. What he said was heresy.

closing.content: The council chamber was closed to many of us tonight. Whatever decisions were made inside, they were final.
